soldier: Head deep brown tinged with black, glossy, densely covered with short pubescence, the anterior margin and the mandibles blackish brown, thorax and abdomen pale greyish yellow. Head rectangular but rather short, the lateral margins parallel, the anterior margin slightly concave, the posterior margin nearly straight; labrum semicircular, its tip slightly concave; mandibles hooked, each with a large blunt tooth at or slightly behind the apical third, and one minute tooth above the base of each; antennae with 14 segments, the third slightly longer than the second; postmentum club-shaped, the waist 0.25–0.28 mm wide; pronotum saddle-shaped, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave and depressed.
